title: Etale sections lift over the pair-neighbourhood colimit
statement: Let B be a commutative ring and J an ideal. Let C be the full category of rings under B whose structure map is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] and whose canonical quotient map B/J to D/JD is bijective. Assume C is essentially small in the universe of B and filtered. Let c be a colimit cocone of its inclusion into rings under B [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], with vertex B to H, and assume B/J to H/JH is bijective. For every etale H-algebra A in the universe of B and every H-algebra map sigma : A to H/JH, there exists an H-algebra map tau : A to H whose reduction modulo JH is sigma.

source.place: Tag 0A02, paragraph verifying condition (2) of Tag 09XI

proof.text: Pass to the small equivalent filtered category and forget the under-ring cocone. The forgetful functor preserves this connected colimit. Descend A directly over this cocone: choose an etale finite-type subalgebra model over a finitely generated Z-subalgebra of H, factor that subalgebra through a finite stage, and base-change its etale algebra to that stage. Tensor cancellation identifies A with H tensor_C D. This is the private proved helper descend_etale, using the Mathlib model and factorization declarations directly, without a comparison with the chosen colimit.
Compose sigma with the inverse descent isomorphism and restrict to the right tensor factor D. Apply the stage-section theorem to obtain a C-algebra map t:D to H with the prescribed reduction.

Use the tensor-product universal property with the identity H to H and t to construct an H-algebra map from H tensor_C D to H. Compare its reduction with the transported sigma using liftEquivRight: the restrictions to D coincide by the stage-section theorem, and both maps fix H. Compose with the descent isomorphism to obtain tau; the inverse identities prove its reduction is sigma.
